name: admin-dashboard-widgets-stuck-loading-fix
hook: Fetch timeout needed for admin dashboard widgets
body: Admin dashboard widgets (MetricsProvider and RecentTransactionsWidget) had no fetch timeout — if the API hung, loading stayed true forever and all widgets showed 'Loading...' permanently. Fix: add AbortController with 30s setTimeout, pass signal to fetch, clearTimeout on all exit paths, treat AbortError as 'timeout' error.
why: This is a common UX pattern — any fetch that can hang indefinitely needs a timeout. The same fix was needed for RecentTransactionsWidget (which fetches separately from MetricsProvider). Without it, users see a permanently frozen loading state.
